tests.command: cd care_fe && npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint <changed files> && npx prettier --check <changed files>
tests.result: tsc: only pre-existing BrowserWarning.tsx @/supportedBrowsers error; eslint: 0 errors, 14 warnings (react-hooks/set-state-in-effect syncing server data into local form state; 2 are pre-existing lines in PatientIndex/PatientRegistration); prettier: all files formatted. No unit tests added; no browser run against a live backend.

corrections: nhcxApi.getPractitioner/updatePractitioner TRes is {ok, message, profile} (backend views_global.PractitionerProfileView), not a bare profile.
A19 actions also include 'suggestions' and 'address' (backend AbhaView) beyond the six listed in CONTRACT.md; the S14 create flow needs them to choose an ABHA address.
Backend extras used though not in CONTRACT.md: POST claims/{id}/discharge/ (S11 discharge details) and POST claims/{id}/queries/{query_id}/ack/ (S10 send acknowledgement).
notes: All screens read the A17 claim state (GET claims/{id}/state/); mutations go through useClaimAction which toasts the server message or the {error} refusal and invalidates the state. While any leg is waiting (checking/submitting/fetching/asking...) state refetches every 5s (user instruction, overrides S6's manual refresh).
Payer shown as payer_name, else payer_id, everywhere (utils.payerLabel). Screens never build FHIR.

Routes: /facility/:facilityId/claims (S5), /claims/search and /claims/search/results (S1/S2 single page with result state in the URL), /claims/discovery (S17), /claims/:claimId and /claims/:claimId/:tab (S6 with tabs in episode order). 'Claims' nav entry after Billing.

ABHA: the page sends plain digits (Aadhaar, OTP, ABHA number, mobile); the backend seals plain values under the ABHA certificate itself (services/abha._sealed). A19 asks for in-page sealing; if that becomes mandatory, seal in AbhaDialog.run via GET abha/certificate + WebCrypto RSA-OAEP SHA-1.
ABHA gender 'Other' is left blank on the CARE form (CARE genders are male/female/transgender/non_binary); never guessed.

S13 'Register with ABHA' searches patientApi.search with the facility's ABHA instance-identifier config (system https://healthid.abdm.gov.in) and the formatted ABHA number; a hit opens the patient verify page, otherwise patient/create?from_abha=1&abha_*=... which AbhaFormButton fills completely and labels 'Filled from ABHA <number>...'. The ABHA identifiers are written into the matching required/optional identifier rows; the ABHA address only when the facility has a config with system .../address.

S15: chip 'ABHA <number>', 'Link ABHA'/'Verify ABHA' (A19 then POST abha/link {txn_id, patient}), 'Search insurance policy' (claims/search?id_type=AbhaNumber|MobileNo&id_value&patient) and 'Claims' (claims?patient&patient_name) are placed in PatientProfile's actions sidebar. Per-row S13 actions were not added to the PatientIndex search results to keep the change isolated; they are on S15.

S16: CARE has no practitioner master; the NHCX practitioner profile card sits on the user summary page (UserSummary) via /api/v1/nhcx/practitioner/{user external id}/. Editable by the user or a superuser (backend enforces). Specialty is a code + display text pair (no SNOMED picker wired). Consultation fee/phone/email from S16 are CARE user fields, not duplicated.

Assumptions in claim tabs: unlink admission sends encounter:null; line edits re-POST lines/ with line_id and unit_price; form answers and attachments are saved through draft/; resubmit-mode query answers go via submit {kind, reply} (mode from next_send kind and adapter==='pmjay'); the status enquiry button is hidden for pmjay; biometric capture sends Aadhaar in clear to the server; S17 discovery opens via POST claims/ with purpose discovery; no document download endpoint so doc.url is linked; local HBP package is a text input; 'Withdrawn under' shows preauth.claim_ref; doctor options show user_type; diagnosis picker is SNOMED ValueSetSelect plus manual ICD-10 code; the LM100 line is computed client-side for display only; ClaimTab gate opens when preauth approved/queried or a claim submission exists.
i18n: all labels added to public/locale/en.json under nhcx_* keys, verbatim from the S specs where the spec gives the text; sorted with npm run sort-locales.
